positions.position: Interested in booking with advance payments on the site
Does not want payments on the site, too complicated

conflicts.resolution: Meena rejected payments and Lakshmi agreed to defer it, deciding no online payments for version one and using WhatsApp instead.

dimensions.justification: Goal is to promote tourism for Velugu Cove and attract more customers, measured by website visitors and WhatsApp enquiries in the first month.
Target audience includes tourists from Hyderabad and Bangalore, accessing via mobile phones and desktop.
Lakshmi (homestay & rooms), Ravi (menu, timings, directions), Meena (boat tours, safety info) are all captured.
One single page site featuring sections for homestay, restaurant, and boat tours.
WhatsApp button with pre-filled text, map directions link, menu, room details, and tour details are fully specified.
Some Given/When/Then criteria provided for the WhatsApp button and sections, but not for all requirements.
Each business owner provides their own text and photos; Lakshmi coordinates collection and developer optimizes them.
Calm natural look chosen, sunset photos mentioned, but no specific colour codes or style guide references provided.
Mobile-first and responsive design mentioned across devices, but specific load time threshold and accessibility are gaps.
Budget of $400 is specified, deadline is before the season starts next month, and simple handover is requested.

out_of_scope: Online payments for the first version

acceptance_criteria: Given a visitor clicks the WhatsApp button, When the chat opens, Then it opens a WhatsApp chat with the relevant business phone number and a pre-filled greeting message.
requirements.description: A button on the website to initiate a WhatsApp conversation with the business owners with pre-filled greeting.
requirements.title: WhatsApp Contact Button

requirements.description: Website content in English and Telugu.

acceptance_criteria: Given a visitor views the homestay section, When they check available rooms, Then they can view room photos, descriptions, basic amenities, and a WhatsApp button.
